notes: STUDIO REBUILD, PHASE 1 — the Studio now opens on a real DAW screen. The Timeline is the home: transport, per-track ARM (●) / mute / solo / volume / meters on every lane, and a working RECORD button — arm a track (or let Rec arm one for you), hit ● Rec, play your keyboard, and the take lands on the timeline as a clip, beat-accurate, without overwriting anything (busy tracks get a fresh 'Take n' lane with the same voice). The Editor (step grid / piano roll / voices / FX) is the second pill of the same tab — double-tap any clip to open it, as before. Pads and Sketch (Song / Ideas) follow. Phases 2-3 (editor drawer on the timeline itself, undo, clip trim/split, pan) are next.
